svg.title: Default versus escalation
svg.desc: Left: every agent step, including classify, extract, format, tool glue, draft, and plan, goes to GPT-6.2 Astra. Right: glue and draft go to GPT-6.2 Sol; the plan and any step where the score is the product go to Astra; Sol escalates to Astra after two failures at high, on the same task id.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: SAME PROJECT KEY · YOU CHANGE THE SLUG
